description:
Return the upcoming match schedule, optionally filtered by series.

Args:
    series_id: Optional. Filter to a specific series. If omitted, returns
               all upcoming fixtures across all active series.
    limit: Max matches to return, 1..200 (default 50).
    offset: Number of matches to skip for paging (default 0).

Returns:
    data.matches: page of matches dated today (UTC) or later, with teams,
        date, venue; filtered to ``series_id`` when the source labels series.
    data.pagination: {total, count, offset, limit, has_more, next_offset}.
    meta.source: adapter that served the data.

offset.description: Number of matches to skip for paging (default 0).
offset.title: Offset

series_id.description: Optional. Filter to a specific series. If omitted, returns all upcoming fixtures across all active series.
series_id.title: Series Id

name: cricket_get_schedule
